#| label: setup
# Load the signup file, set the chart style, and keep the headline counts the summary prints.
import os
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

import db

os.environ.setdefault("MPLCONFIGDIR", str(Path(".").resolve() / ".matplotlib"))
Path(".matplotlib").mkdir(exist_ok=True)

plt.rcParams.update({
    "figure.facecolor": "white",
    "axes.facecolor": "white",
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "font.size": 10,
})

GRANT = 200
q = db.q

# Turn a dataframe into a markdown table and show it in the report.
def md_table(frame):
    cols = [str(c) for c in frame.columns]
    lines = [
        "| " + " | ".join(cols) + " |",
        "| " + " | ".join(["---"] * len(cols)) + " |",
    ]
    for row in frame.itertuples(index=False):
        lines.append("| " + " | ".join(str(v) for v in row) + " |")
    display(Markdown("\n".join(lines)))

# Format a dollar amount with no cents.
def money(x):
    return f"${x:,.0f}"

# Format a share as a percent. Show an em dash when the denominator is zero.
def pct(num, den):
    if den == 0:
        return "—"
    return f"{100 * num / den:.1f}%"

# Pull the headline totals for the cohort from the "totals" SQL query.
totals = q("totals").iloc[0]
n = int(totals.n)
n_act = int(totals.n_act)
n_buy = int(totals.n_buy)
n_sql = int(totals.n_sql)
spent = float(totals.spent)
granted = n * GRANT
n_never = int(totals.n_never)
n_tried = int(totals.n_tried)
n_build = int(totals.n_build)
buy_build = int(totals.buy_build)
spend_build = float(totals.spend_build)
over200 = int(totals.over200)
purch_before = int(totals.purch_before)
sql_before = int(totals.sql_before)
sql_no_buy = int(totals.sql_no_buy)
buy_no_act = int(totals.buy_no_act)
n_buy_after = int(totals.n_buy_after)
mar = int(totals.mar)
first_after_buy = int(totals.call_after_buy)
